title: Technique Variation System
description: Extend build_mesh_system_prompt() in mesh_context.py to accept an explicit technique assignment. Each batch member gets assigned a specific modeling technique (primitives, curve_sweep, radius_closure, bi_rail_loft, loop_cut, boolean) instead of discovering it through escalation. The system prompt says 'You MUST use [technique]. Do not switch approaches.'
definition-of-done: 1. build_mesh_system_prompt() accepts optional technique parameter. 2. Six technique prompts defined (primitives, curve_sweep, radius_closure, bi_rail_loft, loop_cut, boolean). 3. When technique is set, preamble forces the agent to use that technique exclusively. 4. Without technique parameter, existing behavior unchanged.
testing-plan: 1. Call build_mesh_system_prompt(technique='curve_sweep') and verify the preamble contains curve_sweep instructions. 2. Call with no technique and verify output matches current behavior. 3. Verify all six technique keys produce valid prompts.
todos: DONE : Define TECHNIQUE_PROMPTS dict with 6 technique descriptions
DONE : Add technique parameter to build_mesh_system_prompt()
DONE : Inject technique-specific preamble into system prompt
